candidates.description: This vector is related to opening quotation marks and punctuation marks preceding capital letters.
This feature vector activates on masculine and feminine definite and indefinite articles across Romance languages.
This vector represents Roman numerals and related numeric symbols.
This vector is related to Italian possessive pronouns and determiners.
This feature vector activates on sentence-initial words and capitalization markers in various European languages.
This vector represents common Italian noun and verb roots, morphological stems, or proper nouns frequently found in Italian text corpora.
This vector is related to common two-letter syllables or word fragments ending with the letter "i".
This vector represents Italian words, names, and suffixes ending with the letters "io".
This vector represents various inflections and translations of the copular verb "to be" across Romance and Germanic languages.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the phonetic or orthographic root "occ" (or closely related variants like "oca", "oce", and "acc").
